name: Limpet XXT (Team 13, UK antweight flipper)
size_rule: robot/profile.py aws2025: 150 mm floor square, no overhang at any height, no height limit. All values are derived by the src/limpet_xxt/params.py relations; the start pose also fits the old 101.6 mm cube (rest length 101.50 mm).

weapon_lock.note: made safe outside the robot: the XT30 is unplugged and the removable link is pulled; the flipper rests on the floor under gravity, no stored energy

parts.label: printed PLA tub: open top, servo tray with horn slot, snug closed-top motor pockets, standoff columns, lid pads with M2 heat-sets, hinge knuckles

printed centre knuckle + flipper seat (2x M2x8 into heat-sets) + tail lever, screwed to the flipper (moves with it on the flipper joint); the tail end face is the drive face

notes: Generated by robots/limpet_xxt/make_spec.py from src/limpet_xxt/params.py. Manufactured parts are built in their own local frames by src/build_limpet_xxt.py (build(part=...)); the flipper joint pivots on the hinge line, the horn joint on the servo output axis, the wheels spin free on the axles. The drive pin sits radially beyond the tail end face (the tail's angular shadow), so no joint sweep can collide with it. The robot self-rights with the flipper, so it does not claim to drive inverted.
